<div class="wv-epigraph">{{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|“We met a party of village leaders out on the road, Highness.}}<div class="wv-epigraph-cite">{{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|— ''House of Blades'', chapter 2}}</div></div>
''See also: [[Leah Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Leah is a woman of dual identities who transitioned from living as a simple villager to serving in a position of significant [[Authority|authority]]. Originally from [[Bel Calem]], she moved to a Myrian village two years prior to live with her aunt, [[Nurita]], following the death of her mother, [[Kelia]]. During her time in the village, she was known as a charming and well-liked resident who shared a close, sisterly bond with a girl named [[Rutha]]. She often wore a silver bracelet featuring a white crystal, which was believed to be a keepsake from her mother. As her circumstances changed, Leah assumed a much more commanding and regal role. She has been seen managing complex administrative tasks, issuing orders to officers and [[Travelers]], and wearing formal attire such as gold, black, and crimson dresses. Her status is further marked by the use of a crown or silver circlet. In her more powerful state, she possesses striking physical features, including dark hair and blue eyes, though one eye is red. She also carries a raven on her shoulder. Leah has demonstrated leadership by accepting official burdens, making judicial decisions regarding prisoners, and navigating high-stakes political environments with a composed, neutral demeanor.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Leah has dark hair and blue eyes, though she has replaced her left eye with a glowing red substitute. She is often seen in long, expensive red dresses or red-and-gold attire, complemented by a silvered [[steel]] circlet set with a [[ruby]]. Her accessories include a silver bracelet with a milky white crystal on her left wrist and she has been seen with a raven on each shoulder.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|A spy and an Overlord, Leah is capable of faking tears and shock to manipulate men. She has accepted the burdens of her royal office and holds a position of great [[Authority|authority]] as [[the Queen]] of [[Damasca]]. When taking the lead, her mannerisms are noted to be uncomfortably similar to those of her aunt, [[Nurita]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Leah is the daughter of [[Kelia]] and [[King Zakareth the Sixth]]. She is the sister of [[Talos]], who was her opponent in the succession and is set to serve her as [[Queen]]. Her aunt is [[Nurita]], and she travels with allies [[Simon]] and [[Alin]]. Leah is also a captive of [[Malachi]] and is referred to as 'Doll' by [[Indirial]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|As a [[Ragnarus Traveler]], Leah possesses a [[Source]] in the form of a four-pointed crystal star that allows her to summon and empower [[Lirial]] devices. She can [[construct]] crystals, use a [[scrying lens]] to observe events, and has the power to take a life with a stray thought. Her skills include wielding a tall [[Lightning Spear]], sealing targets with crystal, and using a token to send individuals directly into [[safe]] lands.}}

{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Leah is a dark-haired, blue-eyed queen and Overlord who has previously called upon [[Simon]] to assist with her missions.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c3">''City of Light'', chapter 3</ref><ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c4">''City of Light'', chapter 4</ref><ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c11">''City of Light'', chapter 11</ref> She holds a birthright to open the [[Crimson Vault]] and maintains a [[Traveler]]'s bond with both [[Ragnarus the Crimson Vault|Ragnarus]] and the [[Crystal Fields]] of [[Lirial]].<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c4" /> While she can afford the [[Queen's communications crystal]], she once had to explain a delay in her mission to seven [[Travelers]].<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c8">''City of Light'', chapter 8</ref><ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c9">''City of Light'', chapter 9</ref> An Overlord who wears a [[ruby]] crown, Leah wields a tall [[Lightning Spear]] and a [[Ragnarus spear]].<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c4" /><ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c9" /><ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c11" /> She utilizes a round crystal mirror [[scrying lens]] and possesses a token capable of sending individuals directly into [[safe]] lands.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c10">''City of Light'', chapter 10</ref><ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c15">''City of Light'', chapter 15</ref> Using her [[Lightning Spear]] causes her body to shake with pain, a condition that requires [[Alin]] to take care of her.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c14">''City of Light'', chapter 14</ref><ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c15" />}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">17</span></div>

=== {{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Overlord in Avernus}} ===
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Currently residing in [[Avernus]], Leah maintains a camp located outside of [[Cana]] and possesses ancestors who once utilized the [[Hanging Tree|Hanging Trees]].<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c17" /><ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c19">''City of Light'', chapter 19</ref> She emerged from the [[Avernus Gate]] with a raven perched on each shoulder, marking her status as the sole remaining active [[Ragnarus Traveler]].<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c20">''City of Light'', chapter 20</ref><ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c21">''City of Light'', chapter 21</ref> While [[Simon]] is likely with her on the hill, Leah utilizes floating [[Lirial]] crystals to gather reports from other [[Travelers]].<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c21" /><ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c22">''City of Light'', chapter 22</ref> After suggesting she could follow the King into [[the House]], Leah entered the [[Crimson Vault]].<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c22" /><ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c24">''City of Light'', chapter 24</ref> Her tactical battle plan involves forming lines outside of a Gate to fight a retreat into [[Elysia]], a location she knows is the King's true goal.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c25">''City of Light'', chapter 25</ref><ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c26">''City of Light'', chapter 26</ref> Leah is capable of tracking a target's destination and informed [[Alin]] that [[Grandmaster Naraka]] was permitted to come as a peace offering.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c25" /><ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c26" /> Dressed in a silver circlet and an expensive, long red dress, she has replaced her left eye with a glowing red substitute and carries a raven on her left shoulder.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c26" />}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">16</span></div>

=== {{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|At the Elysian Gate}} ===
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Positioned at the edge of the [[Elysian Gate]], Leah stood behind a defensive wall composed of [[Travelers]] and [[Golems|golems]].<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c27">''City of Light'', chapter 27</ref> While facing the [[Ragnarus Incarnation]], she used her abilities to seal the creature's legs with a layer of crystal.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c27" /> During this confrontation, [[Zakareth]] advised her to conserve her power for potential emergencies.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c27" /> Leah also possesses her father's eye.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c27" />}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|[[Leah]] is facing the [[Ragnarus Incarnation]].<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c27" />}}</li>

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|“We met a party of village leaders out on the road, Highness.<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c2" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|"And of course you know my daughter, Heiress Leah."<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c12" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|"I accept this burden," Leah said, recovering herself.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c15" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|“Incarnation of Valinhall, you have slaughtered your way through my country for too long. In punishment for your crimes, I command you to drop your weapons and await execution.”<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c21" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|“Can’t have the Queen of Damasca losing her strength.”<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c25" />}}
